objective: Classify every required R1B family by exact historical pregame custody and semantic parity. No analogous substitution, zero fill, outcome-reading replay, price input, or post-hoc history restriction may be promoted to parity.

classificationPolicy.PARITY_CERTIFIED: Exact frozen family semantics are reproducible for the intended historical universe with immutable pregame custody, explicit temporal provenance, no target leakage, and no market-price inputs.
classificationPolicy.PARTIAL_PARITY: Valid pregame upstream custody or exact builder semantics exist, but full-universe and/or exact current-family parity remains unproven.
classificationPolicy.BLOCKED: Exact current-family historical pregame semantics cannot presently be certified without unsupported substitution or missing source custody.
